item.title: [WebCryptoAPI] Missing 'iv:' clause
item.content:encoded:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/SubtleCrypto/encrypt

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

#aes-cbc_2, #aes-gcm_2

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

return window.crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: "AES-GCM", iv }, key, encoded);

return window.crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: "AES-CBC", iv }, key, encoded);

What did you expect to see?

return window.crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: "AES-GCM", iv:iv }, key, encoded);

return window.crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: "AES-CBC", iv:iv }, key, encoded);

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

No response

Do you have anything more you want to share?

No response
